views:
SELECT d.id AS document_id,
    d.owner_id,
    r.id AS revision_id,
    r.mode,
    r.limitations
   FROM (documents d
     JOIN source_revisions r ON (((r.id = d.published_revision) AND (r.document_id = d.id))))
  WHERE (d.ready AND (NOT d.deleted) AND (r.status = 'published'::text) AND r.upload_complete AND ((r.mode = 'complete'::text) OR (r.skip_confirmed AND (jsonb_array_length(r.limitations) > 0))) AND (( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM source_pages p
          WHERE (p.revision_id = r.id)) = r.page_count) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM source_pages p
          WHERE ((p.revision_id = r.id) AND ((p.status <> 'ready'::text) OR (p.page > r.page_count)))))));
